threads.body: [General] This only skips propagation fields that are immediately adjacent to the first one. If an ordinary or unknown field appears between two field-8888 maps, the generated processor later calls `readFieldBegin()` again, which treats the second map as a new first field, starts another span, and overwrites `currentRequest`/`currentContext`; the earlier span is still leaked. Track whether propagation has already been processed for the current message (resetting that state in `readMessageBegin`) and skip every later field-8888 map, regardless of intervening fields.

[Testing] Add regression coverage that feeds many repeated field-8888 maps through the decorated server protocol and verifies parsing completes without stack growth and exactly one server span is ended. Include a case with a normal/unknown field between propagation maps so the non-consecutive duplicate path is covered as well.
